turnover_ratio.description:
TurnoverRatio is units issued divided by average stock held: how many
times the shelf emptied and refilled over the period.

client_request_id.description: ClientRequestID makes a retried offline scan idempotent.

quantity.description: Quantity is signed: positive adds, negative removes.

product_ids.description:
ProductIDs narrows the count; empty means every product holding stock at
the chosen scope.

cogs.description:
COGS is the FIFO cost of the goods removed, populated for outbound
movements only.

duplicate.description:
Duplicate is true when ClientRequestID matched an already-applied
movement and nothing changed.
